In this notebook, I will make plots for Main Figure 3

# Setup

```{r setup}
library(Seurat)
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidygraph)
library(ggraph)
library(viridis)
library(nichenetr)
library(multinichenetr)

thisseed <- 231103

colFGID <- "#1E88E5"
coliCD <- "#55D276"
colcCD <- "#FFC107"
colUC <- "#D81B60"
diagSubColVec <- c("FGID"=colFGID, "iCD" = coliCD, "cCD"=colcCD, "UC"=colUC)

diagSub.comp <- list(c("FGID", "cCD"), c("iCD", "cCD"), c("cCD", "UC"), c("FGID", "UC"))

colCelltypes <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 7, "Set1")[c(1:5,7)]
names(colCelltypes) <- c("ColEpi", "Stroma", "Myeloid", "Plasma", "BCell", "TNKILC")

`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

logInf <- function(x){ifelse(x == 0, log(1/1000), log(x))}

moveNode <- function(thistblgraph, name, xnudge = 0, ynudge = 0){
  thisrow <- which(thistblgraph$name == name)
  thistblgraph[thisrow,"x"] <- thistblgraph[thisrow,"x"] + xnudge
  thistblgraph[thisrow,"y"] <- thistblgraph[thisrow,"y"] + ynudge
  return(thistblgraph)
}

# From RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12,)
annoColVec <- c("IBDAssocEpi" = "#FB8072", "Venule" = "#8DD3C7", "IBDAssocFibro" = "#80B1D3", 
                "IBDAssocMonoMac" = "#B3DE69", "IgGPC" = "#BEBADA", "GALTB" = "#FCCDE5",
                "Thelper" = "#FDB462", "Tfh" = "#BC80BD", "Treg" = "#FFFFB3", "NK" = "#D9D9D9")

nichenetannoVec <- names(annoColVec)

contrast_tbl <-  tibble(contrast = 
                        c(
                          'cCD-UC',
                          'UC-cCD'
                        ),
                      group = c("cCD","UC"))

source("../functions/ComparisonPlottingFxns.R")
```

# Correlation

```{r}
obs <- readRDS("out/annotations/scvi/251017__predictCOL_CB_allcells_obs.rds")
obs
```


```{r}
cellstates <- obs %>% distinct(cellstate, .keep_all = T) %>% arrange(cellstate) %>% droplevels %>% pull(celltype, cellstate)
cellstates
```

```{r}
selectedCorrListNetworkDF <- read_csv("out/correlation/Th1Th17Tfh_Correlation_Edges.csv")
selectedCorrListNetworkDF
```

```{r}
CellFreqDF.wide.scored <- read_csv("out/correlation/Th1Th17Tfh_GeometricMeans.csv") %>%
  mutate(diagSub = fct_relevel(diagSub, c("FGID", "iCD", "cCD", "UC")))

CellFreqDF.wide.scored
```

## Networks

```{r}
corr.list <- list(
  Th1 = selectedCorrListNetworkDF %>% filter(cellstate == "Th1") %>% select(from, to) %>% as.matrix %>%  as.vector %>% unique,
  Th17 = selectedCorrListNetworkDF %>% filter(cellstate == "Th17") %>% select(from, to) %>% as.matrix %>%  as.vector %>% unique,
  `PD1Hi Tfh` = selectedCorrListNetworkDF %>% filter(cellstate == "PD1Hi Tfh") %>% select(from, to) %>% as.matrix %>%  as.vector %>% unique
)

corr.list
```


```{r, fig.width=30, fig.height=10}
minCorrFilter <- 0.35
minCorrShow <- 0.5
selectedCorrGGraph <- selectedCorrListNetworkDF %>%
  arrange(correlation) %>% 
  filter(correlation >= minCorrFilter) %>%
  mutate(correlation = ifelse(correlation < minCorrShow, 0.1, correlation)) %>% 
  group_by(cellstate) %>% 
  as_tbl_graph %>% 
  mutate(celltype = cellstates[name]) %>% 
  activate("edges") %>% 
  mutate(cellstate = fct_relevel(cellstate, c("Th1", "Th17", "PD1Hi Tfh"))) %>% 
  ggraph(layout = 'kk', maxiter = 150) 

th1shift <- -1
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "TFPI2Hi Fibro.", 0.5, 0.75)
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "Inflm. Mac", th1shift, 0.5)
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "Th1", th1shift, 0.5)
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "Treg", th1shift+0.35, 0.75)
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "XCL+ NK", -0.5, 1)

th17shift <- -0.5
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "CCL24+ Gob.", th17shift-0.35, 0.35)
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "LGR5+ Epi.", th17shift-0.6, 0.25)
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "Venule", th17shift-0.6, 0.1)
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "MNP", th17shift-0.8, 0.15)
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "Th17", th17shift+0, -0.2)
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "Prlf. Teff", th17shift-0.5, -0.1)

tfhshift <- -2.5
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "SAA+ Epi.", -0.75, 0.15)
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "PDPNHi Fibro.", -1.5, 0.4)
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "IgG1 PC", tfhshift-0.2, 1.1)
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "GC-like BC", tfhshift+0.5, 0.75)
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "Plasmablast", tfhshift-0.25, 0.5)
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "Prlf. BC", tfhshift-0.25, 0.5)
selectedCorrGGraph$data <- moveNode(selectedCorrGGraph$data, "PD1Hi Tfh", tfhshift+0, 0.5)

selectedCorrGGraph +
  geom_edge_fan(aes(width = correlation + 0.25), color = "black") +
  geom_edge_fan(aes(color = correlation, width = correlation)) +
  geom_node_label(aes(label = name, 
                      color = celltype), 
                  fontface = "bold", size = 8, alpha = 1, label.size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(colCelltypes), na.value = "gray90", na.translate = F) +
  labs(color = NULL) +
  ggnewscale::new_scale("color") +
  geom_node_label(aes(label = name), color = "black",
                  fontface = "bold", size = 8, label.size = 0, show.legend = F) +
  scale_edge_color_viridis(option = "magma", guide = "edge_colourbar", limits = c(minCorrFilter,1), breaks = c(0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1)) +
  guides(edge_width = "none") +
  labs(
    color = NULL,
    edge_color = "Correlation"
  ) +
  facet_grid(~cellstate) +
  theme_graph(foreground = 'black', fg_text_colour = 'white', plot_margin = unit(c(0.25,0.25,0.25,0.25), "cm"), border = F) + 
  coord_cartesian(clip = "on", expand = T) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 36),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 24),
    legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 24),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.spacing.y = unit(10, "mm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(1.2, "cm"),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.5,"cm"),
    plot.margin = unit(c(0.25,0.25,0.25,0.25), "cm"),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill=NA, linewidth=2),
  )  +
  expand_limits(x = -0.45) +
  guides(edge_color = guide_edge_colorbar(barheight = 10)) 
```

## Geometric Means

```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
ggplot(CellFreqDF.wide.scored %>% mutate(dummy = "dummy"), aes(x = diagSub, y = geommean.th1, fill = diagSub)) + 
  geom_point(size = 4, shape = 21, alpha = 0.75, 
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.75, seed = thisseed)) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_cl_boot", geom = "errorbar", width = 0.6, color = "black") +
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "crossbar", width = 0.6, linewidth = 0.6, 
               aes(color = diagSub)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diagSubColVec) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = diagSubColVec) + 
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = diagSub.comp, method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.format", size = 7, vjust = 1.25, tip.length = 0.075, bracket.size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~dummy, labeller = as_labeller(c("dummy" ="Th1-Associated Geometric Mean"))) +
  labs(
    y = "Geometric Mean of Th1\nAssociated Cellstate Frequency",
  ) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(color = "black", fill = "white")
  )
```

```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.75, seed = thisseed)) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_cl_boot", geom = "errorbar", width = 0.6, color = "black") +
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "crossbar", width = 0.6, linewidth = 0.6, 
               aes(color = diagSub)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diagSubColVec) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = diagSubColVec) + 
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = diagSub.comp, method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.format", size = 7, vjust = 1.25, tip.length = 0.075, bracket.size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~dummy, labeller = as_labeller(c("dummy" ="Th17-Associated Geometric Mean"))) +
  labs(
    y = "Geometric Mean of Th17\nAssociated Cellstate Frequency",
  ) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(color = "black", fill = "white")
  )
```

## Circos

```{r}
top_lr_overall.sender.thtfh <- get_top_n_lr_pairs(
  multinichenet_output$prioritization_tables, 
  top_n = 120, 
  senders_oi = c("Thelper", "Tfh"),
  rank_per_group = FALSE
  )
top_lr_overall.sender.thtfh %>% select(group, sender) %>% table
```


```{r}
top_lr_overall_prioritized.sender.thtfh <- multinichenet_output$prioritization_tables$group_prioritization_tbl %>%
  filter(id %in% top_lr_overall.sender.thtfh$id) %>%
  distinct(id, sender, receiver, ligand, receptor, group) %>% 
  left_join(top_lr_overall.sender.thtfh)
top_lr_overall_prioritized.sender.thtfh$prioritization_score[is.na(top_lr_overall_prioritized.sender.thtfh$prioritization_score)] = 0

top_lr_overall_prioritized.sender.thtfh
```

## Activity

### Th and Tfh Senders

```{r}
plot.activity.overall.sender.thtfh <- multinichenet_output$prioritization_tables$ligand_activities_target_de_tbl %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  mutate(group = ifelse(contrast == "cCD-UC", "cCD", "UC")) %>% 
  relocate(group) %>% 
  filter(direction_regulation == "up") %>%
  distinct(group, ligand, receiver, activity, activity_scaled, direction_regulation) %>% 
  filter(ligand %in% top_lr_overall_prioritized.sender.thtfh$ligand)

plot.activity.overall.sender.thtfh
```

```{r, fig.width=16, fig.height=5}
activity.max <- abs(plot.activity.overall.sender.thtfh$activity_scaled) %>% max %>% ceiling
ggplot(plot.activity.overall.sender.thtfh, aes(x = ligand, y = receiver, fill = activity_scaled)) + 
  geom_tile(color = "gray80") + 
  facet_grid(group ~ . ) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "darkblue", mid = "#FFFFFF", high = "darkred", 
                       limits = c(-activity.max, activity.max)) + 
  labs(
    x = "Ligand",
    y = "Receiver",
    fill = "Scaled\nLigand\nActivity"
  ) +
  theme_light() + 
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(color = "black", fill = "white", linewidth = 1)
  )
```
